**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 05:38
- [FACT] User is interested in non-touristic places in Florence.
- [PREFERENCE] User prefers to explore underrated locations rather than popular tourist spots.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] San Miniato al Monte is a medieval church that offers breathtaking views of Florence and is not as well-known as other churches.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bardini Gardens are located just outside of the city center and provide a peaceful escape filled with beautiful flowers, fountains, and sculptures, along with stunning views of Florence.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Brancacci Chapel is located inside the Church of Santa Maria del Carmine and features beautiful frescoes, often overlooked by tourists.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Vasari Corridor is a secret passageway built by the Medici family, now open to the public, offering a unique perspective on the city.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Oltrarno neighborhood is located on the other side of the Arno River, filled with artisan shops, local restaurants, and beautiful piazzas, providing a more authentic glimpse into Florentine life.
